children.text: Quartz Sensor endurance runtime was 17.5 hours.
Slate Sensor endurance runtime was 14.2 hours.

root_proposition.text: Quartz Sensor outlasted Slate Sensor in the endurance test because Quartz ran 17.5 hours and Slate ran 14.2 hours.

sources.content: Endurance table: Quartz Sensor operated continuously for 17.5 hours before shutdown.
The competing grey unit ceased operation after fourteen point two hours under the same protocol.
Slate Sensor endurance housing survived 14.2 metres of cable drag testing.
Slate Sensor runtime configuration allows 14.2 second sample windows in endurance mode.
Slate Sensor endurance diagnostics record runtime events to flash memory.
Quartz Sensor uses a sealed battery pack.
Slate Sensor endurance runtime report lists fourteen diagnostic categories for field service.
